title: TriMet Routes
description: All existing bus and rail lines. 200 LineString features covering TriMet's service district in the Portland, Oregon metropolitan area, published by TriMet as `tm_routes` and last updated at the source on July 13, 2026. This is a cloud-native mirror: the same data as GeoParquet and PMTiles, reprojected to WGS84 from TriMet's NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft). The original Shapefile, KML and metadata page are linked as assets. Column descriptions and code lists are TriMet's own, taken from https://developer.trimet.org/gis/meta_tm_routes.shtml.

providers.name: TriMet
providers.description: Tri-County Metropolitan Transportation District of Oregon, the transit agency for the Portland metropolitan area and the originator of this data.

providers.name: Chris Holmes
providers.description: Maintains this cloud-native mirror. Not affiliated with TriMet.

data.title: TriMet Routes (GeoParquet)
data.description: All existing bus and rail lines. Reprojected to WGS84 from TriMet's NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft) source, Hilbert-ordered, zstd-compressed, with a GeoParquet 1.1 bbox covering column for row-group pruning.

table:columns.name: dir
table:columns.description: Direction of route. Values: 0 = Direction 0; 1 = Direction 1.

table:columns.name: frequent
table:columns.description: Indicates whether a route or route segment has frequent service. Values: True = Route segment has frequent service; False = Route segment does not have frequent service.

table:columns.name: type
table:columns.description: Type of service. Values: AT = Aerial Tram; BUS = Bus; CR = Commuter rail; MAX = Light rail; SC = Streetcar.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WGS84 longitude and latitude. Reprojected from TriMet's EPSG:2913 (NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft)).

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>

visual.title: TriMet Routes (PMTiles)
visual.description: Vector tiles for web display, layer name `routes`. Built with tippecanoe keeping every feature at every zoom, so what a map draws matches the GeoParquet exactly.

thumbnail.title: TriMet Routes preview
thumbnail.description: Rendered from this collection's styles/default.json with MapLibre GL Native, over a light basemap. WebP is allowed for thumbnails by spec PR portolan-sdi/portolan-spec#121, which this catalog targets; Portolan 0.1 alone permits only PNG and JPEG.

style.title: TriMet Routes by service type
style.description: Every fixed-route alignment colored by TYPE, following TriMet's own `trimet-routes` MapLibre style: bus lines thin and blue, MAX heaviest, streetcar thin, commuter rail gray. Colors are TriMet's GTFS route_color values, which is what that style resolves at draw time.

style-by-direction.title: TriMet Routes by direction
style-by-direction.description: Colors the two DIR values apart. Each route appears twice in this layer, once per direction, and the two alignments are rarely identical because of one-way streets — this style makes those divergences visible. Offsetting the two directions by a couple of pixels keeps coincident segments from hiding each other.

style-frequent-service.title: TriMet Routes — Frequent Service
style-frequent-service.description: Splits the network on the FREQUENT flag. The 51 route-direction segments flagged True are drawn heavy in TriMet's FX green; the remaining 149 recede to a thin gray, so the frequent-service spine stands out against the rest of the system.

style-labeled.title: TriMet Routes with route numbers
style-labeled.description: The service-type styling with PUBLIC_RTE drawn along each alignment. Use PUBLIC_RTE rather than RTE for display: it is the number riders see, and it is where lettered services such as FX2 appear.

source_shapefile.title: TriMet Routes — original TriMet Shapefile
source_shapefile.description: TriMet's own distribution of `tm_routes`, in NAD83(HARN) / Oregon North (ft). This is the file this collection was built from. Size and checksum are of what TriMet served at the sync time recorded in `updated`.

source_kml.title: TriMet Routes — original TriMet KML
source_kml.description: TriMet's KML distribution of the same layer.

source_style.title: TriMet MapLibre style trimet-routes
source_style.description: TriMet's published MapLibre style for the whole network, from tiles.trimet.org. Its line widths, caps and colors are what styles/default.json follows.
